meta.title: Remote Access Gateway
meta.description: Protect and publish a loopback-only DSH Web GUI through authenticated LAN, Tailscale, or tunnel access.

dsh-remote-access.title: Remote Access Gateway
dsh-remote-access.summary: Manage LAN, Tailscale, and public-tunnel access. Every external request passes through the login gateway.
dsh-remote-access.safetyBody: Do not expose DSH's original port directly. Publish only this gateway and require HTTPS for public access.
dsh-remote-access.lanNotFound: No usable LAN IPv4 address was detected.
dsh-remote-access.tailscaleNotFound: No usable Tailscale address was detected.
dsh-remote-access.tunnelBody: Tunnel controls remain disabled until a provider is configured. Revoking sessions signs out every remote device.
dsh-remote-access.changePasswordBody: Verify the current password, save its replacement, and revoke all remote sessions.
dsh-remote-access.passwordChanged: Password changed. All remote sessions were revoked.
dsh-remote-access.configurationBody: Use “Open configuration file” in the top-right corner for listener, credential-reference, and tunnel settings.
